name: Indolent B-cell Non-Hodgkin Lymphoma

diagnosticCriteria.formalCriteriaName: WHO Classification of Tumors of Hematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues

criteria.description: Presence of small to medium-sized neoplastic B lymphocytes with a nodular or diffuse pattern on lymph node biopsy
Expression of B-cell markers CD19, CD20, CD22 with absence of CD5 and CD10 in most cases
Indolent clinical course with painless lymphadenopathy and absence of B symptoms initially

diagnosticCriteria.minimumForDiagnosis: Histopathological confirmation with immunophenotyping demonstrating B-cell lineage and typical marker expression
diagnosticCriteria.notes: Molecular studies such as detection of t(14;18)(q32;q21) translocation may support diagnosis in follicular lymphoma subtype

pathognomonic.notes: Typically involves cervical, axillary, or inguinal nodes

pathognomonic.symptomName: Bone marrow infiltration by neoplastic B cells
searchTerms: bone marrow filled with cancerous B cells

common.symptomName: Mild anemia due to marrow involvement
searchTerms: mild anemia from bone marrow disease
low red blood cells due to marrow problems
low energy from ongoing health issues

occasional.symptomName: B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)

occasional.notes: Due to paraneoplastic or treatment-related causes

searchTerms: immune system destroying red blood cells
red blood cell breakdown from antibodies

laboratory: Peripheral blood smear showing circulating neoplastic B cells
Bone marrow biopsy with lymphoid infiltration
Elevated serum LDH and beta-2 microglobulin
imaging: CT scan showing enlarged lymph nodes
PET-CT demonstrating low to moderate FDG uptake in involved nodes
genetic: t(14;18)(q32;q21) translocation involving BCL2 gene in follicular lymphoma subtype
Clonal immunoglobulin heavy chain gene rearrangement

distinguishingFeatures: Presence of B symptoms early in disease
Peripheral blood lymphocytosis with smudge cells
Expression of CD5 and CD23 on B cells

redFlags: Development of B symptoms (fever, night sweats, weight loss)
Signs of organ compression or dysfunction
references: Swerdlow SH, Campo E, Harris NL, et al. WHO Classification of Tumours of Haematopoietic and Lymphoid Tissues. IARC; 2017.
Armitage JO. Indolent non-Hodgkin lymphoma: diagnosis and treatment. Mayo Clin Proc. 2010;85(8):746-752.
Orphanet: Indolent B-cell non-Hodgkin lymphoma. ORPHA:300842.
